comment: Reviewed pin for the wallet document shipped in assets/web/index.html. A build verifies the file against this before it is packaged, so changing the wallet requires changing this file in a reviewed commit.
frontendRef: release/2026-11-rollout-prod at f137af3 (#453: failed dApp requests answer with matching error codes; #459: page title and App Store notice; #460, #461: Settings layout by screen width (the app opens its own settings screen); #462: Ink and blue colours for the light theme; #463: shorscan.com as the explorer host; #465: light theme as a choice in every build, driven by the native shells through window.__QRL_SHELL_THEME__, SET_THEME and THEME_CHANGED; #466: the theme follows the system until the user has chosen, and falls back to dark when a shell has stated nothing). The branch is to merge to main with a merge commit, which keeps the commit reachable.
